not_authorized_by_inference: Changing the four native project permission axes
Changing unrelated anonymous endpoints or the native permission to create an anonymous signature record
Associating a legacy anonymous signature with an account solely by matching an email address
Changing corporate signerPHID to synthesize an individual signer
Production activation, deployment, new domains or online permission migration

implementation_profile.verification_get: Authenticate the actual full native session, match immutable stored signer account, check current native document VIEW before returning document or signer metadata.
implementation_profile.verification_post: Actual native CSRF plus current session/account, stored actor, owned verified contact, current document version/VIEW and exact one-use secret; transactional compare-and-set and final source recheck.
implementation_profile.email_provenance: A currently verified native UserEmail row owned by the immutable signer account; verified secondary aliases are supported. Current primary status is not required and form contacts are not silently rewritten.
implementation_profile.notification: Generic challenge text without document title, terms or signer name; exact source/recipient/contact and current document VIEW rechecked at each egress authorization.
implementation_profile.unknown_or_third_party_contact: No verification email is sent. Existing native anonymous signature-record semantics remain; the UI explicitly reports unsupported verification rather than claiming mail success.

compatibility: A legacy individual signature with no signerPHID or corporate signature with no stored actor cannot satisfy immutable-account matching and its verification link is rejected when the candidate is enabled.
No legacy row is adopted by email lookup, backfilled, deleted, re-signed or migrated.
Existing verified records remain unchanged. Repeated authorized verification does not perform another state transition.

Native anonymous signing and other public endpoint permissions are retained. An unbound anonymous record may remain unverified because the explicitly tightened verification endpoint cannot safely identify its signer.
When the candidate is disabled, the original native signing and verification paths remain. The selected tightened semantics are not claimed to be active online.

source_consistency.profile: actual configured single MySQL primary, native People session source, same-primary Legalpad tables, InnoDB and owned transaction
source_consistency.direct_sources: Current native account/session plus signature and document rows are locked; actual viewer DocumentQuery is used, never Omnipotent for document permission.
source_consistency.native_policy_boundary: Application and transitive custom-policy dependencies are queried again before commit. This is not a claim of an atomic closure over every policy, project or plugin source.
source_consistency.get_write_guard: Only identity metadata initialization and explicit transaction bookkeeping use scoped unguarded writes; native policy/application queries run after guard restoration.
source_consistency.fresh_document_queries: Each permission check uses a new actual viewer LegalpadDocumentQuery and private request cache restored in finally. Final consumption repeats this query.
source_consistency.transitive_boundary: Project membership/materialized edges and named-policy sources are freshly queried but not all locked. Last permission query to commit retains the accepted native request revocation boundary; no global atomic closure is claimed.
source_consistency.spaces_boundary: LegalpadDocument does not implement PhabricatorSpacesInterface. No document Space ACL is invented; native request-global Spaces entry remains unchanged.
